title: 1986 AMC 8 Problem 12
statement: The table shown displays the grade distribution of the \(30\) students in a mathematics class on the last two tests. For example, exactly one student received a ‘D’ on Test \(1\) and a ‘C’ on Test \(2\) (the circled entry). What percent of the students received the same grade on both tests?

solutions.text:
A student received the same grade on both tests exactly when counted on the main diagonal. Those entries are \(2 + 4 + 5 + 1 + 0 = 12.\)

So the fraction is \(\dfrac{12}{30} = \dfrac{4}{10} = 40\%.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: A student with the same grade on both tests lies on the diagonal running from the top-left to the bottom-right of the table
Add the diagonal entries, then divide by \(30\) and convert to a percent
